description: Sifter with metal mesh bowl to hold four and black plastic handle. Between handle and sifter is metal neck that has a diamond shape. At side of bowl opposite from handle are two prongs for setting the sifter on edge of bowl. Underside of sifter portion has two strips of metal that forms an "X" across the mesh. End of handle has a teardrop shaped hole.
title: Sifter, Flour
